en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing several large passenger steamships in a harbor. Two ships dominate the foreground, one moored on the right with gangways to the quay and another moving or berthed on the left. Additional ships and harbor structures are visible in the background. The scene is calm, with gentle water and a hazy sky. Printed caption text appears at the bottom-left of the front image.
